authority: Installed host operator only; no visitor HTTP routes, policy import or budget refill
canonicalIdentity: ../src/wire.mjs remains authoritative; same candidate, manifest, artifact, source, semantic key and exact refs across verification generations

configureVerification.compareAndSwap: expectedVerificationId is current verification.id; null only before explicit installation on a legacy pool
configureVerification.result: verification-generation-policy.v1 built from installed source/runtime/evaluator and immutable pool caps
configureVerification.effects: journal scoped policy change, retire prior published evidence, update current profile atomically; no execution or reservation

requestRevalidation.effects: retire old evidence and queue one explicit generation; no automatic execution, budget refill or physical release

execution.reserve: existing installed reserve(projectId, commandId); one attempt per generation, fresh assignment ID and physical fence
execution.supervise: existing installed supervisor; checks retained manifest and current exact source/runtime/profile
execution.reconcile: actual witnessed exit or durable no-launch proof; old assignment cannot complete current generation
execution.publish: publish(projectId,candidateId,generation); omitted generation means 1 and never means latest
execution.recover: one bounded recoverPool pass; only current generation pending publications

evidence: Append-only original observations and receipt bodies; explicit retirement mutations preserve dependency expiry/negative history; no renewed compatibility while pending
migration: 003_vf04_revalidation.sql adds columns and widens attempt/publication uniqueness by generation; no new tables or event store; down refuses to drop maintained generations, recorded execution profile/validity bindings (including generation 1), or maintenance decisions
ownership: VF05 participation, VF06 composition, VF07 advisory allocation, VF08 portable executor remain separate; none can assign a verifier, mint a receipt or refill capacity through these ports
